title: Fix and harden footer social links (Facebook + X/Twitter)

requirements.summary: Replace the placeholder Facebook URL constant with a valid Facebook URL in the shared social links config.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the Facebook icon in the site footer navigates to a real Facebook page URL.

file_operations.description: Update `FACEBOOK_URL` from the placeholder `'#'` to a valid Facebook page URL (full https URL) so the footer uses a real destination.

requirements.summary: Make footer social icons non-interactive and visually disabled when configured with placeholder/invalid URLs; otherwise open valid social links in a new tab with safe rel attributes.
acceptanceCriteria: If `FACEBOOK_URL` is '#', clicking the Facebook icon does not change the page URL or scroll position and does not open a new tab.
If `FACEBOOK_URL` is a valid external URL, clicking the Facebook icon opens the URL in a new browser tab and includes `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
X/Twitter link behavior matches Facebook: opens in a new tab when configured to a valid external URL; otherwise it is non-interactive and visually disabled.

file_operations.description: Add a small URL validity check (e.g., using `new URL()` and requiring http/https) and conditionally render each social icon as: (1) an external `<a>` with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"` when the configured URL is valid, or (2) a non-link element (no `href`, no navigation) with a disabled visual state (e.g., reduced opacity + not-allowed cursor + no hover transition) when the URL is invalid/placeholder. Apply consistently to both Facebook and X/Twitter; keep LinkedIn as a normal external link.
